messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: It's crazy how PlayStation keeps doing everything wrong and taking L after L except where it actually matters (money) so they won't do anything to change.

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: It's a weird situation. PlayStation has the bigger brand name, I feel, among gamers. The sales support that. MS just has the deeper wallets and this has been the case since the OG Xbox launched. Sony can shit on a plate and smack it in to the face of their users like a pie and people will still value PlayStation more than they do other companies. Nintendo can do the same. MS is the scapegoat when all the other companies employ the same bad practices.

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: That being said, they're all bastards and I won't sweep for any of them. Each company understands they have a role to play and the end game ultimately favors all of them.

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: Very true. Though PlayStation did lose a lot of good will among it's fanbase during the PS3 era, especially at launch.

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: I stopped gaming in 2013, right after the XBone and PS4 were announced. Never touched an eight gen console and got a Series S in 2021. So my last impression of the Console Wars™ was the 360 and PS3 were neck and neck, trading blows. One could argue one was slightly better than the other. I had no clue the 8th gen was such an abortion. But it was obvious when the PS5 was impossible to find and the Series X came with a slap from the scalper that sold it to you.

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: The PlayStation brand is a lot stronger than I thought it would be. And for people who think Nintendo is still kid-oriented, it's either PS or Xbox and like 70% of the world seems to favor Sony

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: Personally I'm done with them after '28. Getting rid of physical games was the last straw. And I say that as someone whose been a bit of a Sony fangirl since '98

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: I haven't owned a Sony console since the PS2 but I still value Sony for the exclusives it has. More so in the last year since they said they weren't coming to PC anymore, otherwise before that, MS and Sony were two sides of the same turd to me.

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text:
They were the last bastion for full physical games (apart from Nintendo). Now that's gone, there's no point in owning their console imo. A system with a walled garden where you can only buy their games digitally from their storefront where they *will* dictate the prices because there's no competition is a stupid idea and something I want no part of.
So unless they backtrack on their no discs and no disc drive in the PS6 ideas, I'm done with them.

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: I see. I am in the camp of digital games being fine for me. I haven't bought physical in a long time. Since 2013, I bought 4 Xbox360 games right before COVID hit because they were 4/$40 lol

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: But it seems like physical media is a big thing for some people but I can't say that the inevitable isn't going to happen with physical media

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text:
I care about ownership and preservation so it's a big deal to me. And if I have to go all digital then PC is the place to be, because of multiple storefronts keeping the prices competitive, and some even let you fully own the game with no DRM (like GoG). Oh and no extra fee just to play online of course.

There is no "inevitable" outcome for physical media. Music is still sold on CD's and Vinyl and even cassette tapes. Movies are still sold on DVD's and Blu-Ray and 4k discs. Books are still printed. There zero reason why games can't do the same, other than if a corporation deems they want to take away our options because it benefits their profits of course. 

It won't die because a lack of people want it, it'll be murdered at the hands of greed and taken from us to increase some shareholders profits.

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: Sorry about the rant lol

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: I hear ya. I get people want to own their titles. I get around that by sailing the high seas lol

messages.author: Queef Huffer
messages.text: It's not physical but still in my possession were the worst to happen

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: Yeah, fair. That's yet another advantage of PC i suppose.
